Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent character key-pose sprite sheet for the Demian game.
Input images: image 1 is Negar's real appearance (subject identity reference only); images 2 and 3 are Setayesh and Darya, style references only. Draw ONLY Negar. Preserve Negar's short dark brown bob, side-swept dark bangs, warm brown eyes, friendly soft smile, pale cream/lilac headscarf with tiny dusty-pink floral motifs draped over the crown, bright lemon-yellow open collared short sleeve shirt over yellow top, fine gold necklace, black wristwatch on her left wrist. Her lower clothing is not visible in the reference; complete coherently with charcoal relaxed trousers and black/cream sneakers. Do NOT copy another person's hair, tattoo, cat or nose ring.
Style: detailed polished chibi retro pixel illustration, same large expressive head and compact full-body proportions as the Darya/Setayesh sheets, warm subtle pixel shading, clean distinct edges. Plenty of face detail and floral scarf details. Identity consistent across ALL frames.
Canvas: approximately 2048x1792, landscape 8 columns x 7 rows, STRICT exactly 56 full body sprites, eight evenly spaced sprites per row. TRUE transparent alpha, no background/checkerboard, no title, captions, frames, labels or grid lines. Each complete silhouette stays inside its own cell with large transparent gutters and feet on a consistent local baseline. No ground shadows or particles.
Row 1 = 8 turnaround views in this EXACT order: front south; front-left southwest; left profile west; back-left northwest; back north; back-right northeast; right profile east; front-right southeast.
Row 2 = 8 successive gentle idle/breath/blink poses facing three-quarter right (east).
Row 3 = 8 successive side-right walk keyframes with distinct alternating feet and arm swing.
Row 4 = 8 successive side-right jump phases: anticipation, takeoff, tucked rising, apex, apex stretching, falling, preparing contact, landing. Keep feet within cells, no world translation.
Row 5 = 8 side-right crouch keyposes, bent knees (not slide).
Row 6 = 8 side-right landing recovery keyframes, low bend to standing.
Row 7 = 8 successive Negar signature 'Smile Bloom' celebration keyframes facing three-quarter front: hands neutral; left hand rises to cheek; palm rests on cheek (like her photo); cute head tilt and wink; right hand makes a tiny finger heart; delighted smile; hand lowers; relaxed smiling finish. These are real individual animation keyframes, NOT eight identical pictures.
Avoid: extra people, props, cats, weapons, text, tattoos, loose particles, merging adjacent sprites, cropped hands/feet/headscarf, realistic adult proportions.

Edit target image 1, the Negar animation sheet. Supporting image 2 is the real subject identity. Fix this production sheet: ALL 56 sprites must be FULL BODY FROM HEADSCARF TO BOTH COMPLETE SHOES. The current bottom row has cropped trousers and missing feet: REPLACE all eight bottom-row portraits with full-body versions of the SAME poses and face, charcoal full-length relaxed trousers, black/cream sneakers. Also ensure every head and every shoe in every row has transparent margin. Preserve first six rows' same identity, lemon-yellow shirt, lilac cream floral scarf, short dark bob, necklace/watch, chibi pixel art style and exact pose ordering. Use a larger approximately 2048x2048 canvas with 8 columns x 7 rows; each cell has enough vertical space for a complete full-length person and a transparent gutter. Row 7 must show the standing feet and complete legs even during hand-to-cheek / wink / finger heart. Same character size across all rows. Do not show head-and-torso avatars. Do not crop or cut any person off at the waist or knees. Do not add any text or particles. True transparent background. Exactly 56 distinct sprites arranged 8 per row, all complete.

No background, text, grid, shadow, extra people, decorative hearts or accessories not present in the identity. Genuine alpha transparency.
